question: Which river is the main source of water for the Hirakud Dam?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahanadi River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mahanadi River** is the main source of water for the **Hirakud Dam**.
 
• Hirakud Dam is located near **Sambalpur** in the state of **Odisha**, India.
 
• The dam is built across the Mahanadi River and is considered the **longest earthen dam in the world**.
 
• The Mahanadi River originates in the **Dhamtari district of Chhattisgarh** and flows through **Chhattisgarh and Odisha** before draining into the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• The river is known for its extensive drainage basin which supports agriculture and is essential for irrigation in the surrounding areas.
 
• The Hirakud Dam plays a significant role in **flood control, irrigation, and hydropower generation** in the region.
 
• The dam helps to manage the water resources of the Mahanadi River effectively and supports the livelihoods of millions of people living in Odisha and Chhattisgarh.
